own.label: Our own advice, drawn from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: No separate task: this pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, crime, money — and the platinum is the last thing you unlock.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is the first story mission of the game. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its story missions in order. Story trophies pop as you go — just keep following the main mission markers.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its story missions in order. Nothing extra to do; the trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its story missions in order. The trophy pops when the chapter's last mission is done.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its story missions in order. The trophy pops when the chapter's last mission is done.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the last story beat, so it comes after every chapter trophy — finish the story and it pops.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission, so follow the main mission markers until it appears, then play it through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Follow the main mission line; the trophy pops when the heist is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Follow the main mission line; the trophy pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the main mission line; the trophy pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, a mission set at Vice City International Airport. Follow the main mission line until it appears.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Follow the main mission line; the trophy pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own completion stat. That means finishing the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles this guide tracks — use the checklist here as your completion list, and check the in-game stats screen for whatever is still missing.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across the whole game — jumps, airtime, near misses and drifts all count toward the running total. It is cumulative, so it builds up naturally if you drive fast and take jumps; dedicated stunt runs in open areas speed it up.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once: fishing, arcade games, the Shooting Range, races, drone races, bowling, meditation, hunting and stranger missions are the activities this list names. Open each one once and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 challenges in all, per PSN's count. Learn each challenge's scoring, pick the right weapon for the range, and retry until gold; the short challenges are the place to practise first.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone-race location. Learn each course's line first with a practice run, then race to win; every location needs one win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race you win for the first time counts once. Work through the race types and locations; repeat wins of the same race do not add to the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, learn what the challenge asks for, and out-fish him in that challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Pick the shortest arcade game you can find and play it through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — play Andy's missions until his final one, then complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for Andy's marker.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand — play Kenton's missions until his final one, then complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for Kenton's marker.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand — play Billy's missions until his final one, then complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for Billy's marker.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each stranger has a chain of missions; finish any 8 chains to the end. There are more than 8 strangers, so you can skip a chain you dislike.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — play Randy's missions until his final one, then complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for Randy's marker.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — play Tyrone's missions until his final one, then complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for Tyrone's marker.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the map; visit each one and meditate there until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a specific animal — follow his missions until the hunt is offered, then take the animal down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets of the same series. Track which sets you have finished and hunt the missing cards for the next set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are spread across the map — find 100 of them and interact at each. This is a long grind, so tick them off as you travel rather than saving them for last.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — stunts, races, activities and more. Any 50 count, so do the easy ones first and let the total build up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Use a fast car, break line of sight, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear — your partner must be with you when the stars drop.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your Wanted level between them. Plan a route past three shops, keep the heat on, and do not let the stars clear until the third robbery is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in, or get close to, 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Variety matters, not repeats: car parks, traffic and dealerships are the fastest way to tick new models off.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In a single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Find a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave the airport in a way the airport did not schedule. This reads like a single specific stunt at VCIA, so treat it as missable: attempt it the first time you are at the airport with a fast vehicle, and keep a manual save from before the attempt.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the Rhino is the series' tank. Expect a tank-related moment or vehicle; until the game is checked, treat it as a single event and attempt it when a Rhino appears rather than assuming it can be repeated.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time. Vault robberies are the big heists of the crime strand; complete five and get away clean after each one.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take it, and lose the Wanted level that follows.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every named area of the map. Drive the whole map, including the smaller towns and coastline, until every region has been visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida; hit one operation per gang until each gang has been robbed once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and take in the view. It reads like a single story or scene moment, so do it the first time the game offers it and keep a save from before.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle straight through the showroom's front. This reads like a one-off set piece, so treat it as missable and keep a save from before the attempt.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl at that alley and complete the follow-through. It names one specific alley, so do it the first time you visit rather than assuming every alley counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The vague wording points at a story or partner beat rather than a grind — play the partner strand and this should pop from a specific moment in it. Exact trigger not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This is a story-choice trophy: a decision in the story locks it in, so it is missable — make the choice, and keep a manual save from before the decision if you want the other outcome later.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The wording points at a retry — a second attempt at something that failed the first time. If a story moment gives you one retry, take it; keep a save from before the first attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A story-event trophy with a deliberately vague description — it pops from a specific story moment. Play the story and it will come; there is no grind to do for it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — hit the pins with a melee attack from a moving vehicle at a bowling alley. Line the vehicle up with the lane and swing as you pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total counts toward the $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, food and gear — every shop purchase counts toward the running total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage the game sells; check the property list and buy the ones you do not own yet.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register vehicles you own or find, and repeat until 10 are registered.
